secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: API token that can edit Workers scripts and D1.
secrets.generate: Cloudflare dashboard > My Profile > API Tokens > Create Token > template 'Edit Cloudflare Workers', add permission Account > D1 > Edit, restrict to your account.
secrets.rotate: yearly, or when someone with access leaves

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.generate: Cloudflare dashboard > Workers & Pages > right sidebar 'Account ID', or: wrangler whoami
